name: io.github.VictoriaMetrics/mcp-victorialogs
description: MCP Server for VictoriaLogs. Provides integration with VictoriaLogs API and documentation

environmentVariables.name: VL_INSTANCE_ENTRYPOINT
environmentVariables.description: URL to VictoriaLogs instance (it should be root URL of vlsingle or vlselect), for example http://localhost:9428 or https://play-vmlogs.victoriametrics.com. Required unless VMC_API_KEY is set, cannot be used with VMC_API_KEY

environmentVariables.name: VL_INSTANCE_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Optional: authentication token for VictoriaLogs API

environmentVariables.name: VMC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional: API key from VictoriaMetrics Cloud Console (if you have VictoriaLogs deployments in VictoriaMetrics Cloud). Required unless VL_INSTANCE_ENTRYPOINT is set, cannot be used with VL_INSTANCE_ENTRYPOINT

environmentVariables.name: VMC_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional: base URL of the VictoriaMetrics Cloud API, https://api.victoriametrics.cloud by default

environmentVariables.name: MCP_DISABLED_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated list of tools to disable
